notes: Root cause of the previously-failing progress_json_reel_valide: the JSON object/array parsers did not skip whitespace after a comma. At byte 5412 of PROGRESS.json (right after '],\r\n') the parser expected a key but found '\r'. Fixed by calling skip_ws(b, i) after consuming ',' in both object() and array().

The minimal JSON parser handles UTF-8 multibyte correctly: string() advances the byte index by c.len_utf8() (not 1 per char), so French accents in PROGRESS.json titles/notes do not desync parsing. Verified by progress_json_reel_valide passing on the real file.
progress.rs is a new untracked module; main.rs now declares 'mod progress;' and wires the 'progress-check' subcommand to progress::check(path) instead of the previous stub().
The uncommitted crates/xtask/src/golden_trace/mod.rs (T0.3.1 golden trace gen, unreferenced by main.rs) is left on disk as before.
